Comment: CycleCity pipeline: ingest, transform and check one month. An outline: every state is a Pass until task 23.

Ingest.Comment: TODO(task 23): a Task on arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke on your function, with the execution input ({"month": "YYYYMM"}) as its payload. Retry FeedUnavailable and Lambda.ServiceException (IntervalSeconds 10, MaxAttempts 2, BackoffRate 2), never FeedNotFound. Catch States.ALL into Alert.

Transform.Comment: TODO(task 23): a Task on arn:aws:states:::glue:startJobRun.sync on your job, with the --month argument from the month that Ingest returned. Catch States.ALL into Alert.

Check.Comment: TODO(task 23): a Task on arn:aws:states:::athena:startQueryExecution.sync in your workgroup and database, running SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT ride_id) FROM trips. Catch States.ALL into Alert.

Check results.Comment: TODO(task 23): a Task on arn:aws:states:::athena:getQueryResults for the Check query, so the next state can read the duplicate count. Catch States.ALL into Alert.

No duplicates?.Comment: TODO(task 23): a Choice on the duplicate count. It arrives as text in ResultSet.Rows[1].Data[0].VarCharValue (Rows[0] is the header), so StringEquals "0" goes to Succeed and the Default goes to Alert.

Alert.Comment: TODO(task 23): a Task on arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke with {"action": "alert"} and the error as message, then Fail.

Fail.Cause: A step failed or the check found duplicate rides; see the alert.
